title: Delivery approvals
description: Review a specific milestone and keep the client's decision with its original version.
noClient: Link a client to the project first.
noMilestones: Create a milestone in the client overview before requesting a review.
requestNote: This text will be visible to the project client. After requesting changes, update the milestone before requesting a new review.
requested: Review registered. The client can respond from the project page.
requestError: Could not request review. Refresh and check the milestone and client before retrying.
error: Could not load reviews. Refresh to try again.
staleNote: The milestone or client changed. A new review is required.
decisionNote: Your decision is recorded for this version. It does not automatically change the milestone's progress.
decisionError: Could not confirm your decision. Refresh to check its status; the version may have changed.
